stories.headline: SEC rule would let investors take exam to qualify as accredited
stories.body: In addition to proposing broader access to private market investments for those who pass a test and for CFPs and other credential holders, the SEC also proposed expanding advisors' ability to charge performance-based fees.

stories.headline: Prediction market traders think the U.S. added more jobs in September than economists estimate
stories.body: The higher-than-consensus expectations are a bet that the U.S. had another strong month of job growth.

stories.headline: Amex accelerates business AI as high-profile alternatives emerge
stories.body: Meta's Muse digital assistant and fintechs have drawn lots of attention, but Amex contends it can harness its long history and ample data to train its internally developed artificial intelligence agents.
